product_one_liner.value: Plannerly is a cloud-based BIM management platform for architecture, engineering, and construction professionals to plan, manage, and verify BIM projects.

employee_band.notes: Prospeo reports 11–20 employees; this is an estimated third-party count.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn and Prospeo report 2017; a Tracxn profile differs, so this is medium-confidence.
